arxiv-2011-02068.title: Exhaustive Entity Recognition for Coptic: Challenges and Solutions
arxiv-2011-02068.creator: Amir Zeldes, Lance Martin, Sichang Tu
arxiv-2011-02068.description: Abstract Entity recognition provides semantic access to ancient materials in the Digital Humanities: it exposes people and places of interest in texts that cannot be read exhaustively, facilitates linking resources and can provide a window into text contents, even for texts with no translations. In this paper we present entity recognition for Coptic, the language of Hellenistic era Egypt.

arxiv-2108-09022.title: Indoor Scene Generation from a Collection of Semantic-Segmented Depth Images
arxiv-2108-09022.creator: Ming-Jia Yang, Yu-Xiao Guo, Bin Zhou, Xin Tong
arxiv-2108-09022.description: Abstract We present a method for creating 3D indoor scenes with a generative model learned from a collection of semantic-segmented depth images captured from different unknown scenes. Given a room with a specified size, our method automatically generates 3D objects in a room from a randomly sampled latent code.

arxiv-2204-02796.title: Molecules in the carbon-rich protoplanetary nebula CRL 2688 Journal: ApJS
arxiv-2204-02796.creator: Jian-Jie Qiu(邱建杰), Yong Zhang(张泳), Jiang-Shui Zhang(张江水), Jun-ichi Nakashima(中岛淳一)
arxiv-2204-02796.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Jian-Jie Qiu(邱建杰), Yong Zhang(张泳), Jiang-Shui Zhang(张江水), Jun-ichi Nakashima(中岛淳一). We present observations of the carbon-rich protoplanetary nebula (PPN) CRL 2688 made with the Institut de Radioastronomie Millimétrique (IRAM) 30 m telescope in the 3 mm and 2 mm bands. In total, 196 transition lines belonging to 38 molecular species and isotopologues are detected, among which, to our best knowledge, 153 transition lines and 13 species are the first report for this object.

arxiv-2209-05518.title: VBF vs. GGF Higgs with Full-Event Deep Learning: Towards a Decay-Agnostic Tagger
arxiv-2209-05518.creator: Cheng-Wei Chiang, David Shih, Shang-Fu Wei
arxiv-2209-05518.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Cheng-Wei Chiang, David Shih, Shang-Fu Wei. We study the benefits of jet- and event-level deep learning methods in distinguishing vector boson fusion (VBF) from gluon-gluon fusion (GGF) Higgs production at the LHC. We show that a variety of classifiers (CNNs, attention-based networks) trained on the complete low-level inputs of the full event achieve significant performance gains over shallow machine learning methods (BDTs) trained on jet kinematics and jet shapes, and we elucidate the reasons for these performance gains.

arxiv-2310-03443.title: The North System for Formosa Speech Recognition Challenge 2023
arxiv-2310-03443.creator: Li-Wei Chen 陳力瑋, Kai-Chen Cheng 鄭楷蓁, Hung-Shin Lee 李鴻欣
arxiv-2310-03443.description: Abstract This report provides a concise overview of the proposed North system, which aims to achieve automatic word/syllable recognition for Taiwanese Hakka (Sixian). The report outlines three key components of the system: the acquisition, composition, and utilization of the training data; the architecture of the model; and the hardware specifications and operational statistics.

arxiv-2405-17340.title: Ω \Omega -Results for Exponential Sums Related to Maass Cusp Forms for SL 3 ​ ( ℤ ) \mathrm{SL}_{3}(\mathbb{Z})
arxiv-2405-17340.creator: Jesse Jääsaari
arxiv-2405-17340.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jesse Jääsaari. We obtain Ω \Omega -results for linear exponential sums with rational additive twists of small prime denominators weighted by Hecke eigenvalues of Maass cusp forms for the group SL 3 ​ ( ℤ ) \mathrm{SL}_{3}(\mathbb{Z}) . In particular, our Ω \Omega -results match the expected conjectural upper bounds when the denominator of the twist is sufficiently small compared to the length of the sum. Non-trivial Ω \Omega -results for sums over short segments are also obtained.

arxiv-2407-08214.title: Towards Stable Training of Parallel Continual Learning
arxiv-2407-08214.creator: Yuepan Li, Fan Lyu, Yuyang Li, Wei Feng, Guangcan Liu, Fanhua Shang
arxiv-2407-08214.description: Abstract Parallel Continual Learning (PCL) tasks investigate the training methods for continual learning with multi-source input, where data from different tasks are learned as they arrive. PCL offers high training efficiency and is well-suited for complex multi-source data systems, such as autonomous vehicles equipped with multiple sensors.

arxiv-2411-05362.title: From Transparent to Opaque: Rethinking Neural Implicit Surfaces with α \alpha -NeuS
arxiv-2411-05362.creator: Haoran Zhang, Junkai Deng, Xuhui Chen, Fei Hou, Wencheng Wang, Hong Qin, Chen Qian, Ying He
arxiv-2411-05362.description: Abstract Traditional 3D shape reconstruction techniques from multi-view images, such as structure from motion and multi-view stereo, face challenges in reconstructing transparent objects. Recent advances in neural radiance fields and its variants primarily address opaque or transparent objects, encountering difficulties to reconstruct both transparent and opaque objects simultaneously.

arxiv-2412-00599.title: Self-regulated growth of galaxy sizes along the star-forming main sequence
arxiv-2412-00599.creator: Shweta Jain, Sandro Tacchella, Moein Mosleh
arxiv-2412-00599.description: Abstract We present a systematic analysis of the spatially resolved star formation histories (SFHs) using Hubble Space Telescope imaging data of ∼ 997 \sim 997 , intermediate redshifts 0.5 ≤ z ≤ 2.0 0.5\leq z\leq 2.0 galaxies from the GOODS-S field, with stellar mass range 9.8 ≤ log ⁡ M ⋆ / M ⊙ ≤ 11.5 9.8\leq\log\mathrm{M}_{\star}/\mathrm{M}_{\odot}\leq 11.5 .

arxiv-2509-08895.title: Polarimetric Diversity in Tidal Disruption Events: Comparative Study of Low-Polarised sources with AT2020mot
arxiv-2509-08895.creator: A. Floris, I. Liodakis, K. I. I. Koljonen, E. Lindfors, B. Agís-Gonzalez, A. Paggi, D. Blinov, K. Nilsson, I. Agudo, P. Charalampopoulos, M. A. Díaz Teodori, J. Escudero Pedrosa, J. Otero-Santos, V. Piirola, M. Newsome, S. Van Velzen
arxiv-2509-08895.description: Abstract Context. Tidal disruption events (TDEs) occur when a star is disrupted by the tidal forces of a supermassive black hole (SMBH), producing bright multi-wavelength flares. Among these events, AT2020mot has so far exhibited the highest recorded optical polarisation, with tidal shocks proposed as the primary source of its polarised emission. Aims.

pmc-10901110.title: Viral pancreatitis: research advances and mechanisms
pmc-10901110.creator: Xianqiang Yu, Minchao Wang, Qingming Kong
pmc-10901110.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Acute pancreatitis is caused by trypsinogen activation in acinar cells caused by various injury forms (gallstone, high triglycerides, alcohol, etc.). Viral pancreatitis is a clinically rare disease type, which is easily neglected by clinicians and causes serious adverse consequences. Viral pancreatitis involves the entry of viruses into pancreatic cells, triggering inflammation, immune response activation, and enzymatic autodigestion, leading to tissue damage and potential complications. At present, there are few available reports on viral pancreatitis, most of which are case reports.

pmc-11312427.title: Potential Benefits of Continuous Glucose Monitoring for Predicting Vascular Outcomes in Type 2 Diabetes: A Rapid Review of Primary Research
pmc-11312427.creator: Radhika Kiritsinh Jadav, Kwang Choon Yee, Murray Turner, Reza Mortazavi, Chrysi Koliaki
pmc-11312427.description: (1) Background: Chronic hyperglycaemia is a cause of vascular damage and other adverse clinical outcomes in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Emerging evidence suggests a significant and independent role for glycaemic variability (GV) in contributing to those outcomes. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) provides valuable insights into GV.

pmc-11476240.title: Distribution of 14 High-Risk HPV Types and p16/Ki67 Dual-Stain Status in Post-Colposcopy Histology Results: Negative, Low- and High-Grade Cervical Squamous Intraepithelial Lesions
pmc-11476240.creator: Karolina Mazurec, Martyna Trzeszcz, Maciej Mazurec, Christopher Kobierzycki, Robert Jach, Agnieszka Halon
pmc-11476240.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Simple SummaryWe studied how different types of high-risk human papillomavirus (HR-HPV) are distributed in early and advanced precancerous cervical lesions to better understand cervical cancer risks. A total of 559 cases were analyzed with results from a diagnostic test for HR-HPV and a special immunostaining method (DS) that helps identify cervical precancer potential that could enhance the effectiveness of the secondary cervical cancer prevention The investigation included a corresponding histology result from a colposcopic biopsy.

pmc-11513642.title: Not so social in old age: demography as one driver of decreasing sociality
pmc-11513642.creator: Julia Schroeder, Jamie Dunning, Alex Hoi Han Chan, Heung Ying Janet Chik, Terry Burke
pmc-11513642.description: Humans become more selective with whom they spend their time, and as a result, the social networks of older humans are smaller than those of younger ones. In non-human animals, processes such as competition and opportunity can result in patterns of declining sociality with age.

pmc-11590221.title: Multidrug-resistant ESBL-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae complex in Czech hospitals, wastewaters and surface waters
pmc-11590221.creator: Lenka Davidova-Gerzova, Jarmila Lausova, Iva Sukkar, Lucie Nechutna, Petra Kubackova, Marcela Krutova, Matej Bezdicek, Monika Dolejska
pmc-11590221.description: BackgroundMultidrug-resistant (MDR) bacteria pose a significant challenge to the treatment of infectious diseases. Of particular concern are members of the Klebsiella pneumoniae species complex (KpSC), which are frequently associated with hospital-acquired infections and have the potential to spread outside hospitals via wastewaters.

pmc-11614602.title: Metabolic pathways, genomic alterations, and post-translational modifications in pulmonary hypertension and cancer as therapeutic targets and biomarkers
pmc-11614602.creator: Xiujin Zhang, Zhiqing Fu, Haijun Wang, Li Sheng
pmc-11614602.description: BackgroundPulmonary hypertension (PH) can lead to right ventricular hypertrophy, significantly increasing mortality rates. This study aims to clarify PH-specific metabolites and their impact on genomic and post-translational modifications (PTMs) in cancer, evaluating DHA and EPA’s therapeutic potential to mitigate oxidative stress and inflammation.MethodsData from 289,365 individuals were analyzed using Mendelian randomization to examine 1,400 metabolites’ causal roles in PH.

pmc-11656653.title: Cancer and Syria in conflict: a systematic review
pmc-11656653.creator: Lena Basha, Hamza Ahmed, Mohamed Hamze, Amaar Awais Ali, Fares Alahdab, Manar Marzouk, Richard Sullivan, Aula Abbara
pmc-11656653.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundArmed conflict can disrupt oncology care profoundly, resulting in worsened health outcomes for cancer patients. Syria has endured armed conflict for over a decade, resulting in a severe breakdown of its healthcare services.

pmc-12605841.title: Development of machine learning models for survival prediction in nasopharyngeal carcinoma using population-based data
pmc-12605841.creator: Guoxiang Lin, Qiyan Mo, Lu Han, Shaohan Sun, Zhiqiang Xiao, Weiming Zhang
pmc-12605841.description: BackgroundDespite significant improvements in treatment efficacy, nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) remains one of the most common and threatening head and neck cancers. This study sought to build a risk stratification model that categorizes NPC patients into distinct prognostic groups based on readily available demographic and clinical variables, with the goal of enhancing patient care and improving survival rates.

pmc-13113987.title: Alpha-Lipoic Acid Inhibits IFN-γ-Induced PD-L1 Expression in Prostate Cancer Cells and Enhances T-Cell-Mediated Anti-Tumor Cytotoxicity
pmc-13113987.creator: Yi-Jan Hsia, Zhang-Min Lin, Tien-Sheng Tseng, Tz-Chong Chou
pmc-13113987.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) plays a critical role for promoting cancer immune evasion. However, the resistance to PD-L1-targeted immunotherapy greatly limits its application. α-lipoic acid (ALA) is an endogenous antioxidant, while whether ALA affects PD-L1 expression remains unknown. In IFN-γ-stimulated castration-resistant prostate cancer (CRPC)-mimicking PC3 and DU145 cells, the expression of PD-L1 and its regulatory genes was determined by Western blotting, RT-PCR, and immunofluorescence. The T-cell-mediated tumor-killing activity was evaluated in a co-culture system of cancer cells and Jurkat T cells.

pmc-13181979.title: Unveiling genetic loci and natural alleles for seed iron accumulation in adzuki bean via genome-wide association study​
pmc-13181979.creator: Yuxin Wen, Jianping Yu, Xiaocao Wu, Liwei Chu, Huizan Li, Xingen Li, Xuehan Zhang, Weiyi Li, Kun Wu, Yongqiang Li, Runzhi Li, Kai Yang, Ping Wan, Bo Zhao
pmc-13181979.description: BackgroundIron is an essential micronutrient for both plant growth and human health and iron deficiency affects over 30% of the global population. Adzuki bean (Vigna angularis), an iron-rich legume, serves as a strategic dietary iron source to combat global iron deficiency anemia. Despite its nutritional significance, the genetic basis of iron accumulation in legumes remains unexplored.

pmc-13371668.title: Radiographic subsidence after single-level anterior cervical discectomy and fusion; a comparison between blade-anchored zero-profile cages and stand-alone cages
pmc-13371668.creator: Shinya Arataki, Akiyoshi Miyamoto, Tadashi Komatsubara, Masato Tanaka
pmc-13371668.description: BackgroundCage subsidence is a common radiographic finding after anterior cervical discectomy and fusion (ACDF), particularly with stand-alone cages, and may compromise postoperative alignment and stability. Blade-anchored zero-profile cages have been developed to provide immediate fixation while avoiding plate-related complications; however, their influence on subsidence characteristics has not been fully elucidated.

pmc-13422405.title: Non-metastatic pediatric head and neck rhabdomyosarcoma: a 24-year retrospective experience from Jordan
pmc-13422405.creator: Arwa Kiswani, Omar Jaber, Ahmad Kh. Ibrahimi, Nasim Sarhan, Yacoub A. Yousef, Mona Mohammad, Rula Al-Qawabah, Iyad Sultan, Hadeel Halalsheh
pmc-13422405.description: BackgroundPediatric head and neck rhabdomyosarcoma (HNRMS) is well characterized in Western cooperative group trials, but real-world outcomes from resource-constrained MENA settings are poorly documented. Whether the locally advanced-stage presentation typical of Middle Eastern referral centers precludes outcomes equivalent to international benchmarks is unknown.
